feed.title: Feed Type
feed.description: Which view of the Protections Report is shown: 'purposes' (why we blocked them), 'recognition' (how they try to recognize you), 'companies' (who we blocked the most), 'activity' (where they tried to track you) or 'top-sites' (which sites had the most trackers). 'privacy-stats' is the retired summary, now only used by the legacy UI and treated as 'purposes' otherwise.

showBurnAnimation.description: Boolean flag to explicitly enable or disable the burn animations

showProtectionsReportNewLabel.description: Display or hide the 'New' badge (label) on the protections report
